name: LLM Subtitle Translator
description: Translates SRT entries to Chinese via DeepInfra (Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct) using a JSON {id,source,text} contract synced from SUCCUBUSQ subtitles.py: verbatim source echo catches content misalignment; strict SRT parsing, structural retries with assistant feedback, binary split fallback, optional glossary + semantic review. API key is fetched at runtime via localhost invoke, never persisted.
